mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds Rate below 0.25% (the effective lower bound) is associated with positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to compressed discount rates and accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% (as measured by a t-test of the mean return being positive, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.0% signals a weak labor market, which is associated with negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to concerns about economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when UNRATE > 5.0% (as measured by a t-test of the mean return being negative, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both the labor market (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) are above their 12-month moving averages, the economy is in a healthy expansion phase, leading to positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when both PAYEMS and INDPRO are above their 12-month moving averages (as measured by a t-test of the mean return being positive, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation rate below 2.0% indicates a low-inflation environment that is associated with positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to accommodative monetary policy and stable growth expectations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation rate < 2.0% (as measured by a t-test of the mean return being positive, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST value below 1050 (thousand units) signals a weak housing market, which is associated with negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to concerns about economic growth and consumer spending.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when HOUST < 1050 (as measured by a t-test of the mean return being negative, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO value below 105 (index 2017=100) signals weak industrial production, which is associated with negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to concerns about economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when INDPRO < 105 (as measured by a t-test of the mean return being negative, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The Federal Funds Rate being below 0.25% (the effective lower bound) is associated with positive 5-day forward S&P 500 returns due to compressed discount rates and accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% (as measured by a t-test of the mean return being positive, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A GDPC1 quarterly growth rate below 0% (QoQ) signals a recessionary economic condition, which is associated with negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns due to reduced corporate earnings and risk aversion.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when GDPC1 QoQ growth rate < 0 (as measured by a t-test of the mean return being negative, p>0.05).
